channel.title: The Inkwell Stoic
channel.description: Your nighttime sanctuary for Stoic philosophy, calm bedtime wisdom, and the quiet art of letting go. One-hour sleep journeys exploring the timeless teachings of Marcus Aurelius, Seneca, and Epictetus — acceptance, resilience, solitude, and inner stillness.
channel.itunes:author: The Inkwell Stoic

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN YOU WONDER IF YOU MATTERED | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This one-hour Stoic sleep meditation is for the quiet hour when you look back over your life and wonder whether any of it truly mattered. It follows that ache gently, without forcing an answer, and lets the night show you the small evidence your tired mind forgets.
Across twelve calm chapters, you will move from doubt, to memory, to the unseen traces of your choices. Let this be a slow companion beside you as the room darkens and the question becomes softer.

item.title: 1 HOUR FOR LEAVING YOUR OLD HOME | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This Stoic sleep meditation is for the last night in a home you are leaving, when the boxes are packed, the rooms feel unfamiliar, and even ordinary walls seem to remember you.
Through 12 quiet chapters, this one-hour reflection walks with you from the final evening to the first pale edge of morning, helping you rest beside change without making the past heavier than it needs to be.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN PAIN KEEPS YOU AWAKE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
When pain keeps you awake at night, the room can feel smaller than your body. This Stoic sleep meditation is for the hours when discomfort, illness, soreness, grief, or old hurt makes rest feel far away.
Across twelve quiet chapters, we move through one long night with patience, tenderness, and old Stoic wisdom made human. You will not be asked to defeat pain. Only to stop letting it own the whole room.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN YOUR WORK ENDS | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This 1-hour Stoic sleep meditation is for the night after a role, career, project, business, duty, or life’s work begins to fall away. When the work that gave shape to your days ends, the mind can mistake the silence for failure, uselessness, or loss of self.
Through 12 quiet chapters, this video walks beside that feeling without rushing it. With calm Stoic reflection, soft modern parables, and simple evening practices, you are invited to lay down the title, keep the character, and rest as someone deeper than what they once did.

item.title: 1 HOUR BESIDE AN AGING PARENT | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
For the quiet ache of watching a parent grow older, this Stoic sleep meditation offers a slow hour of tenderness, restraint, memory, and care. It is for the nights when love feels mixed with fear, impatience, duty, regret, and the strange grief of seeing someone who once seemed permanent become fragile.
Through twelve calm chapters, you will move from resistance toward a steadier form of affection. Not perfect love. Not heroic patience. Just the small, human discipline of staying soft where time has made things difficult.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO END YOUR DAY IN PEACE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
A quiet Stoic sleep meditation for closing your day without guilt. This hour guides you through a gentle nightly review: not to punish yourself, not to reopen every mistake, but to see the day clearly and let it rest.
Across twelve slow chapters, you will move from the first breath beside the bed to the final release of what cannot be repaired tonight. Let the day become simple again. Let sleep arrive without a verdict.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN LIFE WILL NOT MOVE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
For the night when something has already happened, and your mind keeps pushing against the wall. This Stoic sleep meditation is for accepting what cannot be changed without becoming passive, numb, or defeated.
Across twelve quiet chapters, you will walk through the hour between resistance and rest: the email already sent, the person who will not turn back, the body with its own weather, the morning that still belongs to your hands.

item.title: 1 HOUR ABOVE YOUR TROUBLES | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
Lie down with a wider sky above the troubles that followed you into bed. This Stoic sleep meditation uses the view from above to soften money worry, regret, judgment, urgency, and the small private storms that feel enormous at midnight.
Across 12 quiet chapters, you will rise gently from the room, the street, the city, and the years, not to escape your life, but to see it with more mercy. Let the night make your burden smaller without making your heart cold.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN THE DAY WON'T SLOW DOWN | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
For the nights when the day followed you into bed, this 1-hour Stoic sleep meditation helps you soften the noise without needing life to become quiet first. Through 12 calm chapters, we walk through missed messages, crowded rooms, unfinished tasks, public pressure, private irritation, and the strange exhaustion of being pulled in too many directions.
Let this be a slow return to the part of you that the day could not scatter. With gentle Stoic wisdom, quiet modern scenes, and simple practices for the night, you are invited to rest inside the small stillness that remains available, even after a chaotic day.

item.title: 1 HOUR FOR LOVE YOU FEAR LOSING | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
Lie down with the quiet ache of loving someone, some place, some season of life, and fearing that it may one day slip from your hands. This hour is for the heart that loves deeply, but grows tired from guarding what it cannot guarantee.
Through slow Stoic reflection, gentle stories, and small night practices, we learn a quieter way to care: not cold distance, not denial, but affection held with steadier hands.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN TIME RUNS TOO FAST | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This quiet Stoic sleep meditation is for the night when time feels as if it is slipping faster than your hands can close around it. Through 12 slow chapters, we sit with the ache of unfinished years, vanishing hours, aging bodies, changing people, and the small fear that life is moving while you are still trying to arrive.
Let this hour guide you toward a gentler relation with time. Not by forcing you to seize the day, but by helping you inhabit the one hour that is actually here.

item.title: 1 HOUR FOR RESENTMENT YOU CAN'T FORGIVE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
A quiet Stoic sleep meditation for the resentment that still lives in the chest after the apology never came. This hour is not about forcing forgiveness, excusing harm, or pretending the wound was small.
Across twelve slow chapters, we move through the night with Marcus Aurelius, Epictetus, Seneca, and a few ordinary human rooms: kitchens, train platforms, old messages, clenched jaws, and mornings that still belong to you.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO FEEL ENOUGH | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This one-hour Stoic sleep meditation is for the quiet ache of wanting more when your heart is already tired. Through gentle stories, ancient wisdom, and slow nighttime reflection, it helps you soften the habit of measuring your life against what is missing.
Let this be a calm hour for learning that what you have is enough for tonight: the room, the breath, the body, the small meal, the ordinary day, the imperfect life still holding you.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN LIFE FEELS TOO CROWDED | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
A quiet Stoic sleep meditation for the ache of feeling alone in a crowded life — surrounded by messages, voices, obligations, and rooms full of people, yet still carrying a private silence no one seems to notice.
Across 12 slow chapters, this hour moves gently through city noise, unread rooms, family tables, workdays, and late-night solitude, using Stoic wisdom to help you return to the only companionship that never leaves: your own steady soul.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO MAKE PEACE WITH FAILURE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This 1-hour Stoic sleep meditation is for the night after a failure, when the mind keeps returning to what went wrong, what you should have done, and who you fear you have become.
Across 12 quiet chapters, we walk slowly from shame toward steadiness. Not by pretending the failure did not matter, but by learning how to hold it without letting it own the whole room.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN MONEY WORRY KEEPS YOU AWAKE | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
A quiet Stoic sleep meditation for the nights when bills, rent, debt, work, and tomorrow’s numbers keep circling the room. This hour follows money worry gently, not as a problem to defeat before sleep, but as a fear to place back into human size.
Across 12 slow chapters, you will move from midnight counting toward a softer kind of courage: seeing what is yours to do, releasing what belongs to fate, and resting before the morning asks for action again.

item.title: 1 HOUR FOR THE GOODBYE UNSAID | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
Sleep beside the goodbye you never got to say, without forcing yourself to forget, explain, or reopen what life has already carried away. This one-hour Stoic meditation moves gently through the ache of unfinished words, missed chances, quiet departures, and love that had no proper ending.
Across twelve slow chapters, this video offers calming Stoic wisdom for regret, absence, memory, and the tender wish to have said one more thing. Let the night turn the unsaid goodbye into something softer: not a wound to keep pressing, but a small lamp left peacefully in the past.

item.title: 1 HOUR WHEN TOMORROW SCARES YOU | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This one-hour Stoic sleep meditation is for the quiet fear that arrives at midnight, when tomorrow feels too large, too near, and too uncertain. Through twelve slow chapters, this video follows one continuous night: from the tense room before sleep, through the dark hours of worry, toward a softer meeting with the morning.
Drawing gently from Stoic wisdom, this meditation turns ancient ideas into personal, modern comfort for anyone lying awake with unfinished work, unanswered messages, money concerns, decisions, duties, or the simple ache of not knowing what comes next. Let the night become smaller, slower, and kinder.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO GROW OLDER WITHOUT FEAR | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This is a slow Stoic sleep meditation for the quiet fear that appears at night when you notice time moving through your body, your face, your memories, and the life you thought would look different by now. It follows one continuous night beside the mirror, the old photos, the tired body, and the question of how to age without panic.
Through Stoic wisdom reimagined for modern life, this hour helps you meet aging as a passage rather than a threat. You will learn to stop bargaining with time, soften the fear of becoming older, and rest inside the dignity of still being here.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO REST A DRIFTED FRIENDSHIP | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This is a slow Stoic sleep meditation for the friendship that did not explode, did not end with one final wound, but simply became quieter until the silence started to ache. It follows one long night with the empty contact, the unsent message, the old warmth, and the strange tenderness of no longer knowing where you stand.
Through Stoic wisdom reimagined for modern loneliness, this hour helps you stop forcing a faded bond to answer at midnight. You will learn to honor what was shared, release the need to possess what changed, and let the friendship rest without turning love into self-punishment.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO FORGIVE YOUR 3AM REGRET | Stoic Sleep
item.description:
This is a slow Stoic meditation for the regret that returns when the house is silent and the mind has no more noise to hide behind. It follows one long night with you, from the first sting of memory at 3am to the softer edge of dawn.
Through ancient Stoic wisdom reimagined for modern wounds, this hour helps you stop treating regret as a life sentence and begin seeing it as a human mark, a lesson, and a quiet place where repair can still begin.

item.title: 1 HOUR OF STOIC PATIENCE: Sleep While Life Unfolds Slowly
item.description:
Some seasons do not move quickly, no matter how tired you are of waiting. This quiet Stoic meditation helps you soften the restless mind, trust slow growth, and sleep without forcing life to arrive before its hour.
Listen when you feel behind, delayed, uncertain, or worn down by the pace of becoming. Let these words guide you back to patience, steady breath, and the old wisdom that what is ripening in darkness is not wasted.

item.title: 1 HOUR OF STOIC SOLITUDE: Find Peace When You Feel Alone
item.description:
There is a kind of loneliness that wounds you, and there is a kind of solitude that quietly rebuilds you. This sleep meditation guides you into the Stoic art of sitting with yourself without fear.
Let this be a calm night companion for the hours when the world feels far away. Through still rooms, old wisdom, and gentle reflection, you will learn to rest inside your own presence.

item.title: 1 HOUR TO LET GO: Stoic Wisdom for a Quiet Mind Before Sleep
item.description:
Lay down the weight you were never meant to carry. This quiet Stoic meditation helps you release control, soften regret, and return to the small, steady place inside you that no storm can reach.
Listen before sleep, during a lonely evening, or whenever your mind feels too crowded. Let these words move slowly through you, like candlelight in an old room, until the day loosens its grip.
